correctness.rationale: Exact source queue equation (4.6), atom/continuous spatial transport difference, feasible threshold interval and strict scalar monotonicity yield unique PNE. Direct exact moment integration gives U0(-5)=25/2 and V0*=14375/36. Summed queue capacity gaps shrink to zero, and bounded cost gap forces slack fractions 23/48 and 25/48. Analytic desingularization near λ=24 proves first threshold correction −5/192. Independently packaged exact arithmetic and root checks pass; finite simulations are not used for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The primary work explicitly motivates the discrepancy between number of EV customers and energy workload and the rapid rise of congestion. At its physically forced exact capacity boundary, the finding resolves previously unspecified customer-count fractions, second-moment-driven slack shares, and monetary queue pole. These natural operational quantities provide a quantitative and reproducible heavy-load planning sensitivity, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine restatement of 50/50 energy workload.
